title: Drives at South City International School · AquaTerra
description: An Earth Day workshop, two plantation drives and Morpheus Day at South City International School in Kolkata. AquaTerra's work there, run by students, in 2025.
lede: AquaTerra ran {count} drives at South City International School in 2025, between 21 April and 4 July. They combined an Earth Day workshop, Grow Green plantation drives and a two-day Morpheus Day, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts across them.

sections.heading: April: Earth Day and planting
body: In April 2025 we ran Smiles Shared, an Earth Day workshop where volunteers led hands-on sessions on sustainability, waste and action. On 21 April a Grow Green plantation ran alongside the workshop, and on 22 April a second one followed, each noting 70 saplings planted.
The two ideas sat well together. Children heard about waste and sustainability in the workshop, and the planting came the next day so they could put some of it into practice.

sections.heading: July: Morpheus Day
body: In early July 2025 the school held Morpheus Day over two days, 3 and 4 July, and students wore Roots tees with pride. Roots is the streetwear now called [Crftd](/crftd). AquaTerra's volunteers were there for both days.

sections.heading: what the season held
body: All of our work at South City International School fell in one season, from 21 April to 4 July 2025. Across {count} drives and {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, the school hosted an Earth Day workshop, two plantation drives and a two-day event.

learnings: One school, one spring, and a workshop and a planting drive on the same days can make a whole programme.
Earth Day sessions and planting pair well: the ideas from the classroom are easy to see in the soil.
Event days can share a school calendar with planting and workshops, as Morpheus Day did in July after the April sessions.

faqs.q: Has AquaTerra worked at South City International School?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra ran {count} drives at South City International School in 2025, including an Earth Day workshop, Grow Green plantation drives and Morpheus Day.

faqs.q: When did AquaTerra visit South City International School?
faqs.a: Between 21 April and 4 July 2025. The Earth Day workshop and the first plantation drive were in April, and Morpheus Day was in early July.

faqs.q: What is Morpheus Day at South City International School?
faqs.a: Morpheus Day was a two-day school event on 3 and 4 July 2025, where students wore Roots tees, the streetwear now called Crftd.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra plant trees at South City International School?
faqs.a: Yes. Grow Green plantation drives were held at the school on 21 and 22 April 2025, and the drives note 70 saplings planted each.
